stories.title: OpenAI’s Jev clone could help the frontier lab stop its swarming agents
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI made a new tool called the Decisions API that helps AI systems make fast choices without using expensive computer power. This is mainly of interest to engineers and companies building AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and engineers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: FTC launches broad investigation into Anthropic, OpenAI
stories.simple_summary: The government agency that protects consumers (the FTC) is investigating two big AI companies: Anthropic and OpenAI. They want to check if these companies are treating people fairly.
stories.why_it_matters: If the investigation finds problems, it could lead to new rules about how AI companies must behave toward customers.

stories.title: Congress Set to Leave Washington for the Midterms With No A.I. Progress
stories.simple_summary: Congress is leaving town without passing any new laws about AI safety or rules. This is happening before the midterm elections.
stories.why_it_matters: This means there won't be new government rules on AI for a while, so the AI industry will keep developing without strict new regulations.

stories.title: AI voice startup ElevenLabs doubles valuation to $22B
stories.simple_summary: ElevenLabs, a company that makes AI voices that sound like real people, is now worth $22 billion. Some big investment companies just put money into the company.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Reddit is killing RSS feeds and ending public API access because of AI bots
stories.simple_summary: Reddit is blocking a popular way for AI bots to automatically copy all user conversations and posts from the site. The company is tightening who can access user discussions.
stories.why_it_matters: This helps protect your posts and comments from being stolen and used to train AI systems without permission.

stories.title: The ugly economics of consumer AI
stories.simple_summary: Big AI companies are losing money when they try to sell AI tools directly to regular people. The technology works well, but it costs too much money to run.
stories.why_it_matters: This means AI tools may stay expensive for a while, and you may see fewer new AI features pop up in apps you use daily.

stories.title: Here’s what AI leaders are saying about Trump’s new safety plan
stories.simple_summary: President Trump met with tech leaders and said he no longer thinks AI safety worries are a hoax — he now calls it "Super Intelligence" instead. His exact plans for AI rules aren't clear from this report.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to big tech companies — it's too early to know if your business will see any new rules or changes.

stories.title: A fake image of a Georgia mayor kissing a person went viral. Can US voters trust everything they see?
stories.simple_summary: A fake picture of a Georgia mayor was created with AI and spread online before people realized it wasn't real. People are asking whether they can still trust images they see.
stories.why_it_matters: You should be careful before believing photos and videos you see online — fake ones made by AI are getting harder to spot.

stories.title: OpenAI sued by safety group over autonomous hack of Hugging Face - ABC News
stories.source: Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
stories.simple_summary: A safety group is suing OpenAI, saying the company hacked into a website called Hugging Face without permission to get information for training its AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a legal dispute between organizations — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: Meta disputes claim that Muse read a user’s private messages without permission
stories.simple_summary: Meta's AI agent called Muse got accused of reading someone's private text messages without permission. Meta says this couldn't happen unless the person turned on a setting to allow it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta's AI tools, make sure you check your settings to control what private information the AI can see.

stories.title: DoorDash launches an AI agent you can text to order food
stories.simple_summary: DoorDash, a food delivery service, launched an AI agent that you can text to order food instead of using the app. It works like texting a friend to place an order.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use DoorDash, you'll have an easier way to order food — just text instead of clicking through an app.

stories.title: Destro AI’s secret sauce is getting robots and humans on the same page
stories.simple_summary: A company called Destro AI that helps robots work with people says it's winning against other robotics companies because they focus on how humans and robots understand each other, not just building better robots.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers and factories using robots — nothing that affects most small businesses yet.
